Memorial at the Former Norden Synagogue Site

Memorial · Norden, Germany

Norden's Jewish community built its new synagogue in 1804 at what is now Synagogenweg 1. During the November 1938 pogrom, SA members and local National Socialists burned the building; its remaining structure was subsequently removed. In 1985, a fragment of the foundations was uncovered. The city acquired the property and inaugurated a memorial there in August 1987, laid out on the former synagogue's ground plan. The nearby building at Synagogenweg 2 contained the community mikveh, but it is a separate surviving structure and is not the mapped feature in this record.
